title: Chapter 893
text:
"EsGod was really captured?"

In the Ruler's office on Planet Crimson Ring, Uranril received the report from the fleet commander and was slightly stunned.

The Dynasty Ruler was very busy, so after helping Black Star find helpers for the three Universal Civilizations, she did not continue to pay attention to this operation.

Urranrell valued Han Xiao's wish to get rid of EsGod, but she did not really care about this operation. Her mentality was like a billionaire investing a few hundred thousand in a small investment, just to test the waters. Whether it succeeded or not, she could accept it. Now that she received the report of her team's success, she was also pleasantly surprised.

EsGod, who had always been a headache for them, finally fell.

EsGod's existence had always been a worry for the three Universal Civilizations, representing chaos and lawlessness. He had always been the enemy of order, and the two sides drew a clear line on the surface, but sometimes, the three Universal Civilizations relied on his strength.

EsGod's notoriety came from his violence, and while he was violent, he obviously would not mess with the three Universal Civilizations for no reason. Most of the time, his targets were Star Cluster or Supercluster civilizations. Wreaking havoc in the territories of these civilizations was secretly in the interests of the three Universal Civilizations.

On the other hand, the Fallen Ark attracted thugs and wanted criminals from all over the universe. The disadvantage was that EsGod's forces would expand because of this, making it harder to deal with him. It also gave rise to many fanatics who chased after EsGod. The advantage was that it gathered all the villains in the universe, making it easier for the three Universal Civilizations to monitor and catch them all, reducing the pressure on the security of many Star Fields.

Of course, the premise was that EsGod was strong enough. If he was not difficult to deal with, the three Universal Civilizations would not have allowed him to exist.

Now that Black Star had really captured EsGod and helped them get rid of this troublesome enemy, the three Universal Civilizations were happy to see this happen.

This was equivalent to capturing the leader of terrorists like Uncle Lantern, representing the three Universal Civilizations' anti-terrorism efforts. The greater the shadow EsGod left on the galactic residents, the greater the reputation of the three Universal Civilizations.

Uranril nodded with satisfaction. "Very good. Black Star didn't waste my help. Well done."

"EsGod was more or less careless. Otherwise, with his ability, almost no one in the universe can catch him," Clottey said calmly.

He was also an old opponent of EsGod, so his judgment was accurate. If EsGod had decisively teleported away the moment he was surrounded, no one would have been able to catch him.

Unfortunately, this was only a theoretical situation. With EsGod's personality, there was no way he would do such a thing. The prerequisite to becoming the strongest was to not be afraid of challenges. If he only knew how to run, he would not have reached his current fame and achievements. He might have become another type of threat, and the three Universal Civilizations would have eliminated him long ago.

"No matter what, Black Star didn't let me down."

Uranril was getting more and more satisfied with Han Xiao. The battle on Planet Lighthouse had dealt a heavy blow to the Arcane Church's arrogance, and now, they had eliminated a mortal enemy of the three Universal Civilizations. Black Star had only joined for a little more than a year, but he had already brought the dynasty considerable benefits.

…

Not long after the fleet set off, they received a reply from the upper echelons of the empire.

In the middle of the command room, a remote projection appeared. It was the Ruler, Uranril. Seeing this, all the dynasty soldiers present stood up and bowed respectfully. Han Xiao and the other Beyond Grade As also nodded symbolically.

"You have all done very well this time and made a huge contribution to the dynasty. The dynasty will not be stingy with the corresponding rewards."

Uranril stood in front of everyone with her hands behind her back. Her tone was filled with praise.

Facing the leader of the dynasty, everyone maintained the dignity of a Beyond Grade A and only nodded, indicating that they accepted her praise.

"If not for Black Star persuading the Radiant Federation to join the plan, I wouldn't have facilitated this joint operation. I've seen the report. Black Star contributed the most during the capture process, and the dynasty is planning to use Black Star as the core of the subsequent publicity. Do you have any objections?" Uranril turned to look at Han Xiao.

Capturing EsGod was a shocking achievement, and Uranril was prepared to give the majority of the credit to Han Xiao to help him expand his influence.

"Of course not. This is the truth." Milizaus laughed.

The old dragon had been heavily injured during the battle on Planet Lighthouse and had always been brooding over it. Now that EsGod was captured, he felt as if he was drinking a cold soda on a hot day. His impression of Han Xiao became even better.

The others did not have any thoughts. They were still waiting to borrow the Evolution Cube, so naturally, no one would compete with Han Xiao.

"Then, I'll thank the dynasty in advance." Han Xiao smiled.

"Hmm, bring EsGod back as soon as possible. The dynasty will lock him up in the most secure place."

Uranril paused. "By the way, Black Star, you said that the souls of those sealed by the Spacetime Amber will dissipate after a long period of imprisonment, right?"

"That's right."

Han Xiao nodded and immediately understood what the Ruler meant.

"The dynasty wants to study EsGod's body?"

"Yes, EsGod's body has a very high research value. He grasped all kinds of Esper Abilities through genetic chain recombination. If we can crack this ability, the dynasty's genetic technology will improve, and the number of Supers cultivated will increase greatly."

Uranril did not hide anything. "Of course, we will only start this research after EsGod's soul dissipates. How long do you think it will take to destroy EsGod's soul?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin.

"I suggest at least five hundred years in prison."

Uranril pondered for a while before nodding. "Alright, although it's a little long, we should focus on safety."

Five hundred years was nothing to the Red Empire. They had existed for many times longer than that, and some of their strategic plans were even calculated in centuries.

After chatting for a while, Uranril hung up, and the dynasty soldiers present returned to their posts.

Ravenlaude turned to look at Han Xiao and said, "EsGod has been captured. It's your turn to fulfill the deal."

A smile appeared on Han Xiao's face. He raised his hand, and nanoparticles surged, bringing the Evolution Cube to his palm.

"Don't worry, I'm a man of my word. Since you've helped me solve this problem, I won't mistreat you."

…

The three Universal Civilizations reached a consensus and would only announce the news of EsGod's capture after the fleet returned. Because the battle took place in the desolate universe belt, the news was limited, so the various organizations had no idea what happened to EsGod.

Half a month later, the dynasty fleet returned smoothly, and they did not encounter any accidents.

Han Xiao handed EsGod over to another dynasty fleet that came to receive them. The dynasty would lock EsGod up in a top-secret location.

The other Beyond Grade As were satisfied with the Evolution Cube's transformation and left one after another, leaving only Han Xiao to return to Planet Crimson Ring.

He immediately contacted Fu Ding and the others. After a month, Han Xiao met the three of them again.

Since the goal of this trip to the Central Galaxy had been achieved, Han Xiao announced to the three of them that their holiday was over. He then brought the three of them back to his spaceship and returned to the Shattered Star Ring.

On the spaceship, Han Xiao used the excuse of missing them after not seeing each other for a long time to give Fu Ding and Nero a good beating.

Fu Ding was still fine, as he was already used to it. Nero, on the other hand, felt uncomfortable all over. Even his father had never been so passionate before. He was hugged by Han Xiao's large hands and rubbed until he was dizzy.

Reynold thought that he would be treated the same way. He took a deep breath and mentally prepared himself. However, Han Xiao turned around and left, seemingly uninterested in him. Reynold was a little disappointed.

After getting lucky, Han Xiao locked himself in his room and opened the interface to complete the [Mortal Enemy of the Three Universal Civilizations] mission.

[Mortal Enemy of the Three Universal Civilizations] mission completed.

Your accumulated damage to EsGod is 100%. You will receive the corresponding reward.

You have received 200 billion EXP, 1 Random Reward, and [Character Summon Card — EsGod].

Character Summon Card — EsGod: [Esper Ability — Ability Enhancement] — can only be used on Espers whose Grade is lower than the user's. Allows the target's Esper Ability to be permanently enhanced and increase the potential of the Esper Ability. Can only be used once on the same target. Usage limit: 0/3

Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

This ability … is quite powerful.

If a Beyond Grade A of a civilization had this ability, it would be equivalent to an unlimited amount of Esper Ability Potential Enhancement Liquid. Even if it could only be used on Espers, it would be enough to increase the strength of the entire civilization's Supers.

This was a strategic ability!

It was a pity that the person who had this ability was EsGod. With EsGod's personality, he did not seem like someone who would help his subordinates increase their strength.

EsGod collecting these powerful Esper Abilities was equivalent to killing off some of the geniuses who might rise up in the future. If the original owner of this Esper Ability had not met EsGod, he might have become an important guest of an advanced civilization in the future.

Additional Mission Requirements Completed.

You have received an additional reward: Randomly draw three of EsGod's abilities (Talents/Abilities).

Hint: EsGod is an Esper. Some of the abilities that can be drawn have been adjusted according to your class.

You have three slots to draw. You can draw at least one ability each time. You can draw a maximum of three times. Please choose the type of ability you want to draw the first time. Ability/Talent/Both?

Han Xiao rubbed his hands and chose the talent.

Espers were not compatible with his class, and the source of their strength was different. He knew that there were many Esper Abilities that he could not draw.

Since he could choose the type this time, of course, he had to make use of it. In terms of ratio, the probability of drawing a good talent was much higher than drawing a skill.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete.

Please choose one to three abilities from the following five options as the reward:

1. [Particle Structure Reinforcement] – Talent: Immunity to True Damage

2. [Fanatical Believer] – Talent: + 20% Resistance to Abnormal Mental Status

3. [Cell Division Control] – Talent: Consume energy to stimulate cell division, achieving strong self-healing, converting energy into health at a conversion ratio of 1: 3. Maximum recovery of 15% health/second.

4. [Endurance Enhancement] – Talent: + 40% Physical and Energy Resistance.

5. [Battle Talent] – Talent: + 1% to all attributes every minute after entering battle, up to a maximum of 12%.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He had drawn two Molding Talents this time, the first and the third.

His eyes were locked onto [Cell Division Control]. This talent should have been converted from EsGod's' Strong Self-Healing ', and its effect was similar to his [Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control]. It was just that the conversion efficiency was not as high as his own.

Right now, his HP had already exceeded 5,000,000, and the amount of HP he could convert from Energy was less than 10% of his total HP. It was far from the 28% HP recovery per second limit. Increasing his HP recovery rate was definitely worth it.

As for the ability to be immune to True Damage, he already had it, so there was no need for him to choose.

You have received [Cell Division Control].

Your [Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control] is similar to [Cell Division Control] and has been combined.

"Talents can be upgraded." Han Xiaoxin's mind moved.

Some talents of the same series and effect had a higher chance of being combined. For example, if he obtained a higher grade Mechanical Sense talent, the lower grade Mechanical Sense talent would automatically disappear, which was equivalent to the talent being upgraded.

Combination Complete.

You have lost [Cell Division Control].

[Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control] has been upgraded to [Advanced Cell Proliferation Control].

[Advanced Cell Proliferation Control]: Uses energy to proliferate cells and heal wounds. Energy is converted to health at a ratio of 1: 9. Recovers a maximum of 35% health/s.

After combining the two talents, the recovery rate increased from 1: 5 to 1: 9. The recovery speed was even faster, almost doubling. The recovery limit per second also increased from 28% to 35%.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and drew a second skill. It was still a talent type.

Another five talents were randomly selected. Han Xiao browsed through them and chose one of them called [Soul Hot Spring], which increased mental resistance by 120% and reduced the duration of abnormal mental states, recovering soul damage.

Mental resistance was his weakness, and stacking mental resistance had always been an important mission.

The third draw was still a talent. Han Xiao glanced at it and was overjoyed.

Among the five random options, one of them seemed to be the modified ability of [Esper Ability — Black Hole], which could convert a portion of the damage to his energy.

After choosing this ability, the interface showed that [Intermediate Energy Absorption] had been combined with it, and the two talents became one.

Your [Intermediate Energy Absorption] has been upgraded to [Efficient Energy Absorption].

Han Xiao did some calculations.

"If that's the case, my energy conversion efficiency has increased by more than 1.5 times. Furthermore, the upgraded talent gives me an additional 25% resistance, which reduces the damage I receive by a quarter."

Before the upgrade, [Intermediate Energy Absorption] did not have any defensive abilities. After the upgrade, it had the characteristic of [Esper Ability — Black Hole], which directly converted a portion of the damage to his energy and avoided a portion of the damage. It was equivalent to saving energy to recover this portion of his HP.

If his resistance was 50% and he received 10,000 points of theoretical damage, then the effect of the talent before the upgrade would be: Receive 5,000 points of actual damage and absorb 3,000 points of energy.

After the upgrade, the effect would be: Receive 3,750 points of damage and absorb 4,750 points of energy.

The energy recovery was more than the HP loss!
